young_dreamer.label: Young Dreamer
young_dreamer.visual_dna: A 16-year-old Indian boy from Gujarat, medium-brown skin, slim build, oval face, deep brown eyes, thick black slightly wavy hair combed to the side, clean-shaven, wearing a simple cream cotton shirt, faded brown trousers and worn leather sandals. Curious expression and ambitious eyes.

young_trader.label: Young Entrepreneur
young_trader.visual_dna: An Indian man aged 28-35, medium-brown skin, average build, broad forehead, expressive dark brown eyes, thick neatly side-parted black hair, clean-shaven face, wearing a crisp white cotton shirt, dark brown formal trousers and a simple wristwatch. Confident posture, persuasive smile and determined expression. Maintain identical facial features throughout all scenes featuring this character.

mature_businessman.label: Mature Businessman
mature_businessman.visual_dna: An Indian man aged 50-60, medium-brown skin, slightly fuller face, broad forehead, deep brown eyes, receding black hair with subtle grey at the temples, clean-shaven, wearing an elegant cream-colored shirt and dark formal trousers. Calm, experienced and confident personality.

merchants.label: Indian Merchants
merchants.visual_dna: Indian male traders aged 30-55, medium-brown skin, varied facial features, wearing historically accurate 1950s cotton shirts, traditional trousers and simple business attire. Serious expressions, carrying commercial documents and negotiating with customers.

factory_workers.label: Factory Workers
factory_workers.visual_dna: Indian male and female workers aged 20-50, medium-brown skin, wearing simple historically accurate cotton work clothes, shirts, trousers and sarees, hardworking expressions, natural poses.

gujarat_home.label: Humble Gujarati Home
gujarat_home.visual_dna: A modest Indian family home in Gujarat during the 1940s, simple plaster walls, basic wooden furniture, traditional floor seating, small windows, earthy colors, warm natural sunlight, humble and peaceful atmosphere.

aden_market.label: Aden Trading Market
aden_market.visual_dna: A historically accurate 1950s Aden port trading district, stone commercial buildings, merchant warehouses, cargo crates, ships visible near the harbor, international traders, warm desert sunlight, dusty golden atmosphere.

small_office.label: Small Bombay Trading Office
small_office.visual_dna: A modest 1950s Bombay trading office, narrow room, old cream plaster walls, wooden desk, accounting ledgers, ink pens, metal filing cabinet, ceiling fan, wooden windows overlooking a busy Indian street, warm afternoon sunlight.

textile_factory.label: Textile Manufacturing Factory
textile_factory.visual_dna: A 1960s Indian textile factory, rows of industrial weaving machines, cotton and synthetic yarn spools, metal equipment, concrete flooring, large industrial windows, workers operating machinery, warm shafts of natural light.

textile_showroom.label: Indian Textile Showroom
textile_showroom.visual_dna: A premium Indian textile showroom during the 1970s, colorful fabric rolls displayed on polished wooden counters, glass cabinets, cream-colored walls, elegant but accessible interior, warm commercial lighting, customers examining textiles, no readable logos or signs.

shareholder_hall.label: Public Shareholder Meeting Hall
shareholder_hall.visual_dna: A large Indian meeting hall during the late 1970s and 1980s, hundreds of ordinary Indian investors seated on wooden chairs, simple stage, warm overhead lights, historically accurate clothing, atmosphere of excitement and anticipation.

industrial_complex.label: Expanding Industrial Complex
industrial_complex.visual_dna: A massive Indian industrial manufacturing complex during the 1980s and 1990s, enormous factory buildings, steel structures, industrial pipelines, chimneys, storage tanks, workers moving through the facility, hazy morning sunlight, monumental cinematic scale.

business_ledger.label: Business Ledger
business_ledger.visual_dna: A thick brown leather-bound accounting register, aged cream-colored pages, handwritten financial entries in dark ink, slightly worn corners, realistic historical paper texture.

fabric_rolls.label: Textile Fabric Rolls
fabric_rolls.visual_dna: Premium synthetic textile rolls in rich blue, red, cream and gold colors, tightly woven smooth fabric, neatly arranged cylindrical rolls, realistic textile textures.

share_certificates.label: Share Certificates
share_certificates.visual_dna: Historically styled Indian paper share certificates from the late 1970s and 1980s, cream-colored paper, decorative borders, printed financial layouts, handwritten investor details, no identifiable company logos.
